description: We are a team of five young, curious, and creative students who are passionate about space, science, technology, and innovation.We enjoy exploring new ideas, solving problems, and turning challenges into creative solutions. We believe that age is not a limitation when it comes to learning, teamwork, and making a difference.We are excited to participate in NASA Space Apps Challenge, share our ideas, learn from others, and build a project that combines creativity and technology to solve a problems
